result.summary: The page is mostly well rendered, but one defect stands out: a loading spinner is stuck on top of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image even though the image and the rest of the page have fully loaded. No other clear visual defects were found; the clipped carousel item and bottom-cut pizza card are expected scrolling behavior.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner (white circle with a green progress arc) is displayed in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in the 'Popular right now' section, overlaying the ramen image. The image and all card details (title, rating, delivery info) are already fully rendered, so the spinner appears stuck or left over from a loading state that never cleared.
issues.suggestion: Make sure the loading indicator is hidden once the card image and content finish loading (or on load error). Check the image load callback and state handling for this card so the spinner overlay is removed and does not persist over loaded content.
